description: This file is a Java source file defining the class ConnectivityModelFactory, which acts as a factory for creating various objects and data structures related to connectivity models within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.connectivity package. It provides methods to construct instances of Connection, Measurement, ResourceStatus, Source, Target, FilteredTopic, Enforcement, HeaderMapping, LogEntry, and various metrics and mapping contexts, primarily from JSON data or specified parameters.

classes.name: ConnectivityModelFactory
classes.description: A final utility class providing static factory methods to create and initialize connectivity-related objects, including connections, metrics, sources, targets, topics, permissions, mappings, and logs, often from JSON representations.
